scope: active = docs files not under /archive/ (ratchet gate); total = all docs

filters.placeholder: refs containing '<', '>' or '*' are excluded (e.g. docs/specs/<name>.spec.md, docs/plans/*.md)
filters.archiveAware: docs/specs/<name> and docs/plans/<name> also check docs/<type>/archive/<name> so archiving does not spuriously trip the gate; legacy .imm/specs/* also checks archive

note: active includes the five active Specs of the managed-workflow-simplification Initiative, whose scope-bound archive pair is required by the Kernel and does not exist until each task freezes
